# ComplexLODs (lod.michitai.com)

> Feature-preserving level-of-detail (LOD) generator for Unity. Built on an
> original probabilistic-quadric edge-collapse simplifier — no third-party
> code. Locks exterior silhouettes, protects door/window openings and feature
> curves, and releases interior detail in depth-gated stages. Proprietary;
> contact support@michitai.com.

Author: Nichita Levandovici (MICHITAI), Republic of Moldova
Contact: support@michitai.com

## What it does

- Generates LOD chains for Unity MeshRenderer hierarchies and prefabs,
  fills LODGroup components, and can produce per-level texture variants.
- Every level is decimated from the LOD0 source mesh — never chained — so
  errors do not accumulate.
- Byte-identical consecutive levels share one mesh asset.
- Meshes with <= 256 triangles skip decimation and reuse the source.

## Preservation model

- Exterior shell: vertices on the 2D convex hull of 14 viewing projections
  are locked for the whole run — outer bounds can never move.
- Feature chains: boundary, sharp-crease, UV/normal-seam, submesh-change and
  non-manifold edges collapse only along the chain; corners and junctions
  stay; non-manifold endpoints are locked.
- Interior-release ladder: when reduction stalls above the target, interior
  detail is released in stages gated by target depth (>=75% fully preserved,
  >=50% interior chain corners, >=25% interior free, <25% interior boundary
  loops may dissolve). Locks and integrity checks are never relaxed.
- Integrity: link condition, duplicate-face rejection, boundary-loop topology
  guard, flip/sliver/growth rejection, bounded collapse distance.
- Honest reporting: unreachable targets are reported, never faked.

## Presets (mirror ComplexLODProfile)

- Performance: 3 LODs, x2.5 reduction per level
- Balanced: 4 LODs, x2.0 per level
- Quality: 6 LODs, x1.6 per level

## Web demo

- Live viewer with real output on Ship Pinnace (Poly Haven, CC0).
- Upload a model (.obj, .fbx binary or ascii, .stl, .glb/.gltf with embedded
  buffers, .ply ascii or binary-LE) via POST /api/generate: the same
  simplifier runs server-side (worker threads) — the algorithm is never
  shipped to the browser. Generated levels download in the same format as
  the input (single files or all-in-one .zip). Uploads and generated files
  are stored under a job id and auto-deleted after 30 minutes.
